status: written 2026-10-16 before any statistic in results/revision/post7/classshortcut was computed; post hoc and exploratory; changes no preregistered decision

already_known_when_written.e7_json: results/revision/amend7/e7.json: E7c within-drug AUROC Older-primary tier A 0.695, tier B 0.754, Novel tier A 0.534; E7d Older-primary A 0.671; E7e Older-primary A 0.734; additive residual E7c Older-primary A 0.706; trained partner prior a7-prior-partner-train within-drug 0.497; reported kappa against DrugBank 1.284
already_known_when_written.red_team_hand_computation: seed 42 only, not reproduced before writing: per-drug AUROC about 0.89 for adalimumab, golimumab, certolizumab, apixaban, tapentadol, trandolapril, regorafenib; about 0.51 for avanafil, axitinib, cabozantinib, teriflunomide, rabeprazole
already_known_when_written.data_structure_checked: artifacts/amend7/train_pairs.csv has 4,643 pairs over 299 anchors (drug_a) and 313 partners (drug_b), 175 drugs on both sides; no Older drug appears in it by name; ood_old_pairs.csv carries an evidence column for all 648 positives

shared.cohorts: Older-primary (ddiood.amend7_analysis.Truth.cohort('older_primary')) tiers A and B, primary cell Older-primary tier A; Novel tiers A and B as secondary
shared.interval: two-way cluster bootstrap of ddiood.amend7_analysis.draws, 1,000 draws, seed 42 for Older-primary and 1042 for Novel; differences use the same draws (paired)
shared.e7_scores: P averaged over seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4 (ddiood.amend7_analysis.seed_average); E7c key oodold_names / ood_names, E7d and E7e oodold / ood
shared.other_systems: b2mixed-biomedbert seed-averaged oodold_empty / ood_empty; llm-qwen-names oodold / ood
shared.training_graph: training pairs are treated as unordered edges; the class-mates of a test drug d are the training anchors (drug_a) sharing a class with d; a sensitivity variant uses every training drug (drug_a or drug_b)

class_definitions.atc4: ATC level 4 (first 5 characters) from the local DrugBank full XML, names and synonyms lowercased, salt-stripped fallback via ddiood.drugbank.strip_salt; a drug with several codes belongs to each class
class_definitions.stem: USAN stem by longest matching suffix (monoclonal antibodies by target infix) from a fixed list in the script

analysis_1_class_scorer.score: for test pair (d, x): number of class-mates of d that are training-positive with x divided by the number of class-mates of d (primary); variant: divided by the number of class-mates with any training pair with x (class-conditional partner rate, also item 6); drugs without class-mates get a constant score
analysis_1_class_scorer.reported: within-drug AUROC over all drugs and over drugs with at least one class-mate, per definition, plus the paired difference E7c minus scorer
analysis_1_class_scorer.sufficient: the scorer is sufficient if, on Older-primary tier A over all drugs, its point estimate is at least E7c's, or the paired 95% interval of E7c minus scorer contains 0; any definition qualifying is reported with the note that best-of-three is a multiple comparison

analysis_2_split.groups: Older-primary drugs with at least one training anchor in the same ATC-4 class versus none; separately the same stem
analysis_2_split.reported: within-drug AUROC per group with 95% interval and drug counts for E7c, E7d, E7e, b2mixed, Qwen names only; paired difference with-class minus without-class for E7c
analysis_2_split.dependent: class-dependent if, for ATC-4 or stem, the E7c with-class minus without-class difference is at least 0.10 with a 95% interval excluding 0 and the without-class group 95% interval contains 0.5

analysis_3_partial.primary: rank residualization within drug: within-drug centered ranks of logit(E7c) regressed (no intercept, pooled slope) on the within-drug centered ranks of the three class scores jointly; residual within-drug AUROC with the residual held fixed across bootstrap draws
analysis_3_partial.secondary: the same per single class definition; a logistic adjustment (logistic regression of y on the class scores with drug fixed effects, E7c logit added as an offset-free covariate is not used; instead residual = logit(E7c) minus its linear projection on the drug-demeaned class scores)

analysis_4_mechanism.rule: a positive is PK if its evidence sentence matches (case-insensitive) CYP, P-gp, P-glycoprotein, transporter, AUC, Cmax, C max, exposure, clearance, metabolism or metaboliz/metabolis; otherwise PD or other; negatives of the drug are shared by both groups
analysis_4_mechanism.reported: E7c within-drug AUROC per group with intervals; the class scorer the same; descriptive, no decision rule

analysis_5_drugbank.operating_point: DrugBank lookup (1 if listed, else 0) pooled FPR and TPR on the cell
analysis_5_drugbank.e7c: within-drug ROC from placement values: for each positive the share of its own drug's negatives scoring at least as high (ties half), positives weighted by their drug's negative count so the area equals the pair-weighted within-drug AUROC; TPR at DrugBank's FPR and partial AUROC from 0 to DrugBank's FPR, with DrugBank's own within-drug values by the same formula

analysis_6_partner_prior.partner_rate: the partner's overall training positive rate and its spread, to check the near-constant claim; and the class-conditional partner rate (variant of analysis 1)
analysis_6_partner_prior.embedding: frozen microsoft/BiomedNLP-BiomedBERT-base-uncased-abstract-fulltext from the local cache, mean-pooled last layer over the name tokens; score = mean of the top-k cosine similarities between d and the training-positive partners of x, k in {1, 3, 5}, k = 3 primary; descriptive

analysis_7_aliases.own_check: difflib ratio at least 0.75 or a common substring of at least 7 characters between salt-stripped Older names and training drug names, each candidate judged by hand as same moiety, prodrug, metabolite or enantiomer (alias) versus shared stem (not an alias)
analysis_7_aliases.reported: E7c within-drug AUROC with the red-team aliases removed and with all confirmed aliases removed
analysis_7_aliases.flag: aliases matter if removal lowers E7c Older-primary tier A by at least 0.03

verdict_rule.b_class_shortcut_confirmed: analysis 3 shortcut_explains holds AND (analysis 1 sufficient OR analysis 2 dependent)
verdict_rule.a_genuine: analysis 3 residual 95% lower bound above 0.5 AND class_share at most 0.25 AND analysis 1 not sufficient
verdict_rule.c_mix: otherwise, with class_share reported as the share attributable to class
